answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 4898 Country: United Kingdom Title: I was wondering if it was permissible to hold in wind during salaat or do you have to break your salaat if you have to pass wind? Question: I was wondering if it was permissible to hold in wind during salaat or do you have to break your salaat if you have to pass wind? Answer ID: 4898 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1369/1034=H/1429) It is permissible. If holding wind is painful and it causes disturbance in salah then it is allowed to break salah and release wind. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
